solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Expenditure revealed by non-professional

parts.note: something revealed is out in the open
lay means not belonging to a profession, as in a lay opinion

explanation.surface: Spending exposed by an amateur, perhaps an amateur auditor.
explanation.definitionFit: An outlay is money laid out, a sum spent on something.

clue.text: Old pair of females absent

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for female, so two of them make FF; the run of letters across 'of females' is a coincidence, not a hidden word

explanation.surface: An old couple of women are not at home.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who is off is away, not present at work or school.

clue.text: Daughter, with rodent moving around, walked on

indicators.note: letters moving around are shuffled into a new order

explanation.surface: A daughter with a rat scurrying about her feet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'moving around' shuffles D and RODENT together.
explanation.definitionFit: Ground that has been trodden has been stepped on, pressed down by feet.

clue.text: Shorten overly remote war film

parts.note: to abridge a text is to shorten it
overly means too, excessively
remote means far away

explanation.surface: An editor's verdict: trim this excessively distant war film.
explanation.definitionFit: A Bridge Too Far is the 1977 film about the Arnhem airborne operation of the Second World War.

clue.text: Association of actors depart during emergency externally

indicators.note: one thing happening during another sits within it, so one piece goes inside the other
externally points to only the outside letters of the word emergency

parts.note: to quit is to leave, depart

explanation.surface: The actors' union walks out in a crisis.
explanation.walkthrough: 'externally' takes E and Y, the outer letters of 'emergency', and 'during' puts QUIT between them.
explanation.definitionFit: Equity is the trade union for performers in Britain, so an actors' association.

clue.text: Fifteen minutes to gain control over military officer

parts.note: fifteen minutes is a quarter of an hour
to master something is to gain control over it

explanation.surface: A soldier given a quarter of an hour to take charge.
explanation.definitionFit: A quartermaster is the army officer responsible for supplies and quarters.

clue.text: Troublemaker the Spanish urge forward

parts.note: an imp is a mischievous little troublemaker
el is the Spanish word for the

explanation.surface: A Spanish rascal egging someone on.
explanation.definitionFit: To impel is to drive or push something onwards, to propel it.

clue.text: Fearful, Stefan regularly avoided Oriental waters

parts.note: yellow means cowardly, fearful

indicators.note: every other letter of the word Stefan is skipped, keeping the alternate ones

explanation.surface: A frightened Stefan kept steering clear of eastern seas.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly avoided' drops T, F and N from STEFAN, leaving S, E, A.
explanation.definitionFit: The Yellow Sea lies between China and Korea, so it is a body of water in the East.

clue.text: Father's outside toilet, a levelled area

indicators.note: one piece is outside the other, wrapping round it

parts.note: Fr is the abbreviation for Father, a priest; the 's stands for is
loo is a British word for a toilet

explanation.surface: Dad has an outdoor lavatory on a flattened plot.
explanation.definitionFit: A floor is a flat, level surface, the ground of a room.

clue.text: Knife European left on part of loaf

indicators.note: in an across clue one piece on another follows it

parts.note: loaf is slang for head, and the scalp is part of the head

explanation.surface: A European blade left on a bit of bread.
explanation.walkthrough: 'loaf' pretends to be bread but is the slang for head, as in 'use your loaf'.
explanation.definitionFit: A scalpel is the small sharp knife a surgeon cuts with.

clue.text: Star guest primarily vocalised

parts.note: the Sun is a star

indicators.note: primarily, meaning first of all, takes the opening letter of the word guest

explanation.surface: A celebrity guest who sang first of all.
explanation.definitionFit: Something sung has been voiced in song, uttered aloud as music.

clue.text: Pretend leather

definitions.meaning: to pretend or tease, as in only joking
soft leather made from young goatskin

explanation.surface: Fake leather.
explanation.definitionFit: Kid means to fool someone playfully, and also fine leather used for gloves.

clue.text: Family company in GB meeting artist, a slithery creature

parts.note: kin means family, relatives

indicators.note: one piece is in another, placed inside it

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: A family firm in Britain teams up with a painter, a sly operator.
explanation.definitionFit: The king cobra is a large venomous snake, and snakes move by slithering.

clue.text: Italian sculptor to give to charity fifty pound ring

parts.note: to donate is to give to a good cause
L is the Roman numeral for fifty
L is the abbreviation for pound, from libra
O is ring-shaped

explanation.surface: An Italian artist donates fifty pounds and a ring.
explanation.definitionFit: Donatello was the Florentine Renaissance sculptor of the bronze David.

clue.text: Grandma set to retire somewhere in NW France

parts.note: nan is a British word for grandmother

indicators.note: to retire is to go back, so the word set is read backwards

explanation.surface: Grandma is ready to retire to north-west France.
explanation.definitionFit: Nantes is a city on the Loire in north-western France.

clue.text: Key informant is free

parts.note: G is a musical key
a rat is an informer who betrays others

explanation.surface: A crucial informer has been released.
explanation.definitionFit: Gratis means without charge, given for nothing.

clue.text: Asian and Greek character cutting through metal

indicators.note: one piece cuts through another, lying inside it

parts.note: tin is a metal
beta is the second letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: An Asian and a Greek letter slicing through metal.
explanation.definitionFit: A Tibetan is a native of Tibet, a region of Asia.

clue.text: Cautious passage around river

indicators.note: the passage word goes around the other piece

parts.note: a way is a path or passage

explanation.surface: Careful going along the path by the river.
explanation.definitionFit: Being wary means being on one's guard, careful of danger.

clue.text: Companion, a pilot, chewed a sausage

parts.note: CH stands for Companion of Honour, a British order

indicators.note: something chewed is mangled, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A friend and an airman munching a banger.
explanation.walkthrough: 'chewed' rearranges A PILOT into IPOLAT. CH is the Companion of Honour, a British honour.
explanation.definitionFit: A chipolata is a small thin sausage.

clue.text: Private documents one returned to Charlie

parts.note: ID means identity documents, personal papers
I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: returned means the word to is read backwards

explanation.surface: A soldier's papers, one sent back to someone called Charlie.
explanation.walkthrough: Charlie looks like a name or the C of the radio alphabet, but in Britain a charlie is a fool.
explanation.definitionFit: Charlie is British slang for a fool, as in a proper charlie.

clue.text: Heard local sound of sheep

indicators.note: heard says the word for the pub is spoken, not written

parts.note: a local is a pub, which has a bar

explanation.surface: Someone nearby heard a sheep.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain 'the local' is one's neighbourhood pub; BAR said in a non-rhotic accent matches the bleat.
explanation.definitionFit: A baa is the bleating cry a sheep makes.

clue.text: Insect on soft cheese for a short time

indicators.note: in an across clue one piece on another follows it

parts.note: brie is a soft French cheese
a fly is an insect

explanation.surface: A fly settles on the brie for a moment.
explanation.definitionFit: Briefly means for a short while, momentarily.

clue.text: Coach tour arranged around Turkey's capital

indicators.note: the reworked letters go around the other piece
letters arranged are put in a new order
the capital of a word is its first letter, here of Turkey

explanation.surface: A coach trip organised round the Turkish capital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arranged' makes TUOR from TOUR, and 'around' puts T, from 'capital' of Turkey, inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A tutor coaches a student privately, teaching and training them.

clue.text: Some light, flat-bodied fish

definitions.meaning: a beam, a narrow shaft of light
a flat fish related to the shark, like the skate

explanation.surface: A bit of light on a flatfish.
explanation.definitionFit: Ray means both a single beam of light and a flattened cartilaginous fish.

clue.text: Personal vessel among smarter yachts

indicators.note: among says the letters sit within the words smarter yachts

explanation.surface: My own boat moored among the more stylish yachts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'vessel' suggests a boat beside the yachts; it is a blood vessel, one's own.
explanation.definitionFit: An artery is a blood vessel in the body, so one belonging to a person.

clue.text: Alcoholic drink's trademark unknown

parts.note: a brand is a trade name, a trademark
Y is an algebraic unknown

explanation.surface: A spirit's label is a mystery.
explanation.definitionFit: Brandy is a spirit distilled from wine.
